result: Packages built from tools/deb/manifest.tsv are byte-identical to the old scripts' (9 of 9 .debs); the red proof was its own byte-grep check; the comparison found and fixed a missing rcrt1.o row; lint now refuses unshipped products
head: 32700c07a

gate.affected: pkg-manifest-3-gate2 running (escalated to FULL by its *.ld rule; inherited FULL gate 12079 passed / 0 failed)

informational: pkg-manifest-2-proof's red came from its own sanity check: grep -a /usr/lib/niji on the coexist loader. The prefix constant is emitted as immediate stores, so it is not a contiguous string. strace shows the loader opening /usr/lib/niji/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libc.so.6; no product regression (the branch changes no product source)
The proof reuses PKG-MANIFEST-2's products (built from the 5bb3eb4bb tree); no product source changed since

impact.what: libc6-dev and niji6-dev ship rcrt1.o again (the manifest-driven build had dropped it)
manifest lint check: products no file row ships (deb_manifest test)
plants on the manifest, build.sh and system.sh
a new package file is one manifest row (merges clean) instead of a shell line in build.sh/system.sh (conflicts)

improvement: Product checks in proofs must be behavioural (strace of the paths opened), not byte greps: the compiler emits short constants as immediates
